_about: Where each notebook's files are staged on Rakiura. Ticks (nt.portal.done) need no ids: a PI links each part name to a checklist item under Settings > Notebook links, keyed by the notebook path. Staging the verdict file needs a step id: each part names its step's displayId. A notebook-level "step" still works for every part that names none, and RAKIURA_STEP overrides both for one session. A part with no step: members attach its files on the step page.
